**What it is:** A Python tool that generates personalized 7-day nursing study remediation plans from a JSON file of missed topics, spreading them across days with peer-reviewed scope-of-practice language appropriate for practical nurse (PN) level.

- JSON files must contain only topic tags and user notes—never include actual or paraphrased question text from paid question banks
